status: Prospective thresholds frozen before any new-candidate acquisition; exact candidate/tooling identities must be separately reviewed and bound before publication.
sourceScope: A separately reviewed positive full-suffix proof consumer, applied directly to this baseline. The completed dcfc→4cd full cohort remains rejected and is not rerun or pooled.

componentPlan.timingBoundary: Unchanged completed numeric-corrected component screen: native compressed inflation+CRC+strict parse+completed lookup. Source reads, module compilation, two warmups, explicit GC and full output digest remain outside elapsed clocks.

componentTargetPromotion.minimumEffectVsControl: The magnitude of median candidate paired reduction must exceed the largest absolute paired A/A percent change in the same corpus.
requiredGates: All48 planned observations complete without replacement
Separate untimed diagnostic proves actual positive suffix proofs and their numeric/content consumers
componentTargetPromotion.decision: Passing permits consideration of separately frozen full-browser qualification; it makes no import or memory claim.

componentNonTargetRisk.minimumEffectVsControl: The median candidate paired slowdown must exceed the largest absolute paired A/A percent change in the same corpus.
componentNonTargetRisk.decision: A trigger holds or rejects this exact candidate. Ambiguous adverse outcomes are reported and may hold qualification; absence of the trigger is not equivalence/nonregression proof.

futureFullQualification.identicalCodeVariation: Materially smaller than each target effect; no control subtraction.

Exact expected changed package entry set and size accounting
Separate fixed whole-process-tree sampled PSS/private memory qualification
futureFullQualification.sourceBinding: New full source/tooling/fixture/observer identities must be frozen before acquisition. No gain transfer from component or prior baselines.

failurePolicy: No selected retries, overwrite or resume. Preserve every successful, failed and partial child stdout/stderr/status and all unattempted schedule entries. A correctness/source failure blocks that cell; matrix fail-fast is false. No result is promoted from an incomplete48 plan.
interpretation: Each corpus and its identical-code controls is reported separately.
No pooling hosts/corpora or prior studies, subtracting controls, selecting repetitions, removing outliers or changing admission from timing.
Diagnostic counters are compiled into a distinct module and never measured.
External host contention is uncontrolled and assessed descriptively through adjacent A/A controls.
Component native/lookup work excludes browser workers, storage/compression/UI and does not qualify process memory.
